# Dictionary Pagination

**Time Limit:** `1000 ms`  
**Memory Limit:** `128 MB`  
**Source:** [https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/dictionary-pagination/](https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/dictionary-pagination/)  

---

You are given a set of $N$ words consisting of lower case letters of the English alphabet. These words will be used to create a dictionary. In a dictionary the words appear in lexicographical order.

You should answer $Q$ queries of the form:

$w$ $x$: If each page of the dicionary contains exactly $x$ words (with the possible exception of the last page), on what page will be word $w$?

### Standard input

The first line contains the two integers $N$ and $Q$.

Each of the next $N$ lines contains one word in the set.

Each of the following $Q$ lines contains a string $w$ and an integer $x$.

### Standard output

The output should consist of $Q$ lines. Each line should contain a single integer representing the answer for a query. The pages of the dictionary are $1$-indexed.

### Constraints and notes

$1 \leq N, Q \leq 10^5$The sum of lengths of the words in the set is between $1$ and $10^5$The sum of lengths of the words in the queries is between $1$ and $10^5$.The words in the set are pairwise distinct.$w$ is always a word from the set.$1 \leq x \leq 10^5$
